verdict.rationale: Beamer's homepage states an API exists ('API and Webhooks'), so programmatic access is a first-party capability. Nothing documents what the API covers or whether it matches the UI. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, or API markdown at standard paths. That shows no published machine-readable spec, but it does not contradict the claim that an API exists. Missing for 10: documented API reference, evidence of UI-to-API parity across features (posts, segments, NPS, roadmap, analytics, widget settings), machine-readable spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
